name: Yuvina Parthavi
bio: Yuvina Parthavi is an Indian child actress who has appeared in films and commercials. She was introduced as a child actress in AVM Productions television serial Uravukku Kai Koduppom (2011), before making a breakthrough in films portraying a young girl.

credits.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 - AK47
credits.overview: A tight-knit family faces an unexpected crisis that threatens their bond, forcing them to re-evaluate their values and fight to stay united.

credits.title: Right
credits.overview: A desperate father searching for his missing son finds himself trapped inside a police station when a mysterious entity seals the station building, forcing those within to confront their secrets as a deadly game.

credits.title: Madha Gaja Raja
credits.overview: Raja, a witty and fearless young man, becomes entangled in a conflict with a corrupt industrialist while trying to protect his family, friends and the woman he loves.

credits.title: Ka..Ka..Ka.. Aabathin Arikuri
credits.overview: Ka..Ka..Ka.. Aabathin Arikuri is a Tamil movie starring Nassar and Yogi Babu in prominent roles. It is an horror drama directed by Manon M.

credits.overview: Son of a tabla player loses his guitar while he goes to help his friend, a security guard. A burglary attempt takes place and he is worried that he will be caught since the guitar contains his contact details. The movie is about how the hero along with his friend tries to retrieve the guitar.

credits.title: Meow
credits.overview: Four friends who live in an apartment get gruesomely murdered one after the other by an unknown power, which leads to an insecurity among the residents there.

credits.title: Mummy Save Me
credits.overview: A pregnant widow moves into a seaside villa along with her daughter, mother and sister. Strange incidents happen in the house, which scare them. Will they be able to tackle this mess?

credits.overview: A taxi driver is befriended by a medium who tells him that a spirit is trying to communicate with him. Who is this spirit and what does it want?

credits.overview: A conman gains the power to see and communicate with ghosts and decides to use it to make money. His happy-go-lucky lifestyle goes for a toss when a ghost who is his look-alike approaches him with an offer.

credits.title: Athithi
credits.overview: A seemingly happy couple's life is turned upside down in a single day when a stranger walks into their life. He orders them to do the strangest of tasks if they want to see their daughter alive. What does he want?

credits.overview: A straightforward man, who uses violence to settle disputes, decides to mend his ways for the sake of his lover, but when he learns that her family is in danger, he decides to save them at all cost.
